summary: Proposal Phase 1 — Task 6b-2. Wires a corporation_tax (CT600) job to depend on the SAME company's company_accounts job for the SAME accounts year-end, via jobs.prerequisite_job_id (the additive column added by Task 6a, 20260725130000). Implemented as an idempotent linking UPDATE added to public.lifecycle_materialize_jobs immediately before its final RETURN, guarded by p_company_id IS NOT NULL and by ct.period_end IS NOT NULL so a NULL period_end can never cross-link years. The rest of the materialize body — including the Task-1 per-line-period COALESCE lines — is reproduced byte-for-byte from the LIVE definition (md5 7765d483eb09fde669d762246a9f01e9). Additive only: no existing arm, period math, function signature, table, or row is altered. calculate_deadline, the UI, and System B (lifecycle_generate_deadlines_for_job + canonical_deadline_rules) are untouched.

problem.context: The proposal now creates one CT600 job and one Accounts job per compliance period for a company. A CT600 cannot be finalised until the Accounts for the same accounts year are finalised, so the CT600 job must carry a prerequisite reference to the Accounts job. Task 6a added the jobs.prerequisite_job_id column; this task establishes the link at materialize time inside the single-source engine, rather than in the UI, so every proposal-materialized CT600 is wired consistently.
problem.scope: Additive only. CREATE OR REPLACE of lifecycle_materialize_jobs = the live body verbatim PLUS one idempotent linking UPDATE before RETURN. No other function, table, column, or row is touched. The UPDATE only runs when materializing for a company (p_company_id IS NOT NULL) and only writes when the link differs (prerequisite_job_id IS DISTINCT FROM acc.id).

expected_objects.object: lifecycle_materialize_jobs body links CT600 → Accounts: sets jobs.prerequisite_job_id on a corporation_tax job to the id of the company_accounts job with the same company_id and same period_end
expected_objects.verify_via: Static/source: catalog_functions(name_like:'lifecycle_materialize_jobs', include_source:true) — confirm the body contains the idempotent UPDATE public.jobs ct SET prerequisite_job_id = acc.id ... service_type='corporation_tax' / 'company_accounts' / acc.period_end = ct.period_end, guarded by p_company_id IS NOT NULL and ct.period_end IS NOT NULL, and that all other arms (incl. the Task-1 COALESCE lines) are byte-for-byte the prior live body (md5 was 7765d483eb09fde669d762246a9f01e9). Function stays SECURITY DEFINER, search_path=public.

expected_objects.object: After apply, a company with both an Accounts job and a CT600 job for the same period_end has the CT600 job's prerequisite_job_id = the Accounts job's id
expected_objects.verify_via: POST-APPLY behavioural check (needs live proposal data — the jobs table was reset empty at authoring time, so this cannot be verified pre-apply). After applying and materializing a quote for a company that has both company_accounts and corporation_tax lines: db_select jobs where service_type='corporation_tax' — expect its prerequisite_job_id to equal the id of the company_accounts job with the same company_id and the same period_end. Re-running materialize must NOT change the link (idempotent). A CT600 whose period_end has no matching Accounts period_end must have prerequisite_job_id left NULL (no cross-year mislink).

post_apply_followups: Behavioural verify_via for ct600-prerequisite-behavioural is a POST-APPLY check: the live jobs table was empty at authoring (reset by 20260724150000), so no live proposal data existed to prove the link end-to-end pre-apply. Materialize a real proposal for a company carrying both company_accounts and corporation_tax lines, then confirm the CT600 job's prerequisite_job_id = the same-period_end Accounts job id.

Multiple accounts periods for one company: the link is on acc.period_end = ct.period_end, i.e. same accounts year-end. If a company has >1 Accounts period (e.g. a long/short first period plus a normal year), each CT600 links only to the Accounts job whose period_end matches its own — no cross-year mislink. If two Accounts jobs somehow shared an identical period_end (data anomaly), the UPDATE could match either; that is not expected under normal per-period materialize and would indicate duplicate Accounts jobs to investigate separately.
